items.summary: Recommendation: retain only the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation; reject new spend, deployments, monetization changes, experiments, telemetry, forecasts, and unsupported financial claims. Amazon reports $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 from 28 ordered items and 6 shipped items, but it is not site-attributable. AI usage records $901.897533 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 4,926 calls, including 228 errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue covers one day while AI spend covers 28 days, and matching infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment costs, budget ceilings, commitments, and a learning threshold are absent. Clicks, impressions, sessions, conversions, proposal counts, approved work, and SEO outcomes are not financial results. Minimum measurement: matching-period site/content revenue identifiers, a complete cost ledger, budget ceilings and commitments, and an explicit cost-to-learn threshold.

Continue work item 67ebb985-a7b8-47f4-9792-b4d727275c4a only. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate provider commission for 2026-09-21 as unattributed. Reconcile matching-period revenue identifiers against recorded AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs; document missing budget ceilings, commitments, and cost-to-learn threshold. Do not infer margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, forecasts, or causal lift.
